title: My Scarlet and Her Crimson Die 05
description: This work is part of an intimate series of small-format oil paintings that explores the deep emotional resonance of chromatic intensity. Through layered textures and tactile brushwork, these pieces transform rich hues of red into a psychological landscape of passion, vulnerability, and quiet introspection.
